craft_notes: Sthāyin: resolve held (the long grasp). Sanskrit first: grasp prescribed + tāvat/yāvat bound → L4 keeps hold and bound across the break. Rows: row 3 (until-frame kept). Rupture: comma after alone — prescription held, bound stated. Close: end-weight on aloneness (alone twice — the point). Minimal pass: comma kept. Read aloud: hold... till... alone. Rejected: 'meditate' for graha — killed: grasp is grip, meditation diffuses; 'forever' for yāvat — killed: until bounds, forever unbounds.

lines: With wide-awake mind hold waking, and waking alone,
till by your own strength you stand in self, alone.
l4.sanskrit_cite: bodhamātre grahaḥ kāryaḥ suprabuddhena cetasā / tāvad yāvat svasāmarthyāt svaniṣṭhaḥ kevalo bhavet

reads_against.argmap: With fully-awake mind grasp awakening alone, until grounded-alone from own capacity.
c1_essence: Fully-awake mind grasps awakening alone till grounded-alone.
